title: receive_from_peer silently falls back to default transit on index mismatch
description:
File: rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs
Lines: 555-570

Issue: When targets.len() > transit.len(), extra targets silently receive a hardcoded default transit with no diagnostic output.

The default_transit uses path_lifetime: 60 (hardcoded). This is likely intentional per RFC, but:
1. No logging when fallback occurs - makes debugging route issues harder
2. Hardcoded path_lifetime may not match sender intent

Suggestion: Add trace-level log when using default transit.
close_reason: Fixed: added clarifying comment documenting the RFC-compliant silent fallback behavior for targets without matching transits. Logging was considered but this file doesn't use the optional log feature - comment documents intent instead.
